summary: The PETKIT PuraMax 2 lists for $310 less than the Litter-Robot 4 and includes two years of coverage against the Litter-Robot's one. Both track each cat's weight in their apps. The case for the Litter-Robot 4 is ownership: it takes ordinary kitchen bags where the PuraMax 2 uses PETKIT's own, it is rated for cats up to 25 lb against 22 lb, and Whisker's support and parts network is the strongest in the category. Pay the difference if you plan to keep the box for years; save it if you want the most capable box for the money today.
